papers.title: Heterogeneous LiDAR Early Fusion and Learned Re-Ranking Strategy for Robust Long-Term Place Recognition in Unstructured Environments
papers.authors: Judith Vilella-Cantos, Juan José Cabrera, Mónica Ballesta, David Valiente, Luis Payá
papers.affiliations: University Institute for Engineering Research, Miguel Hernández University
papers.intro: 本文提出MinkUNeXt-VINE++方法，通过早期融合两个不同LiDAR传感器（Livox Mid-360和Velodyne VLP-16）的点云数据并引入轻量级学习的重排序策略，在葡萄园等非结构化环境的地点识别任务中取得显著性能提升。

papers.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Cheng-Yu Yang, Shao-Yuan Lo, Yu-Lun Liu
papers.tags: scene understanding, visual grounding, image captioning, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (Cheng-Yu Yang, Yu-Lun Liu); National Taiwan University (Shao-Yuan Lo)
papers.intro: 提出Reroute，一种无需训练的即插即用方法，将视觉token的不可逆剪枝替换为可恢复路由：被推迟的token不永久删除，而是跳过当前阶段并保留在候选池中，在后续阶段可重新评分和入选，从而在不增加计算预算的前提下显著改善定位性能并维持通用VQA表现。

papers.title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
papers.authors: Jadelynn Dao, Milan Ganai, Yasmina Abukhadra, Ajay Sridhar, Mozhgan Nasr Azadani, Katie Luo, Clark Barrett, Jiajun Wu, Chelsea Finn, Marco Pavone
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, University of Waterloo, NVIDIA
papers.intro: 本文提出DIRECT框架，一个利用多模态场景上下文动态路由测试时计算资源的分配方法，通过为每个任务选择最合适的VLM规划器，显著提升了成功率与计算成本的帕累托前沿。

papers.title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jin Yao, Dhruva Dixith Kurra, Tom Lampo, Zezhou Cheng, Danhua Guo, Burhan Yaman
papers.tags: autonomous driving, multimodal learning, scene understanding, point cloud
papers.affiliations: Uber AV Labs; University of Virginia
papers.intro: VLGA首次在VLA模型中引入了一个受密集像素级点图重建损失监督的、参数隔离的几何专家，通过四专家混合变换器架构，同时实现了语言推理、密集空间接地和专用几何容量，在开放环路和闭环驾驶任务上均达到了最先进水平。

papers.title: Illumination-Robust Camera-Based Heart-Rate Estimation for Physiological Sensing in Robots
papers.authors: Zhi Wei Xu, Torbjörn E. M. Nordling
papers.tags: pose estimation, vision transformer, medical image
papers.affiliations: National Cheng Kung University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种端到端时空Transformer框架，集成PRNet 3D面部对齐、剪辑级光照增强、残差时间标准化模块和混合时频损失，在静态多光照协议下将心率MAE降至0.79 bpm，相比PhysFormer降低93.6%。

papers.title: A Turbo-Inference Strategy for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhen Zhao, Gang Zhang, Xiaolin Hu, Liang Tang
papers.tags: object detection, instance segmentation, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: School of Technology, Beijing Forestry University; Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University; Beijing National Research Center for Information Science and Technology, Tsinghua University; Chinese Institute for Brain Research (CIBR)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种无需重新训练模型的涡轮推理策略（Turbo-Inference Strategy），通过引入涡轮检测头（Turbo-Detection Head）和涡轮分割头（Turbo-Segmentation Head），在推理阶段迭代利用检测与分割之间的互补信息，同时提升目标检测和实例分割的精度。

papers.title: DepthMaster: Unified Monocular Depth Estimation for Perspective and Panoramic Images
papers.authors: Pengfei Wang, Shihao Wang, Liyi Chen, Zhiyuan Ma, Guowen Zhang, Lei Zhang
papers.tags: depth estimation, scene understanding, vision transformer, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: DepthMaster通过将全景图像分解为重叠的透视补丁、注入虚拟投影相机的几何先验，并引入对应一致性损失（CCL）作为软约束，在不修改标准Transformer架构的前提下统一了透视和全景的度量深度估计，在13个数据集上达到了最先进的零样本性能。

papers.title: Echoes of the Prior: A Computational Phenomenology of Forgetting
papers.authors: Gege Gao, Bernhard Schölkopf, Andreas Geiger
papers.affiliations: Gege Gao - Eberhard Karl University of Tübingen; Bernhard Schölkopf - Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems; Andreas Geiger - Eberhard Karl University of Tübingen, Tübingen AI Center
papers.intro: 本文提出一个名为“Echoes of the Prior”的交互式艺术安装，通过在3D高斯泼溅模型中引入受控的“突触衰减”，模拟记忆/感官流的结构性退化，从而可视化遗忘的主观现象学，并建立神经形态美学的框架。

papers.title: Natural-Language Temporal Grounding in Hour-Long Videos is a Search Problem: A Benchmark and Empirical Decomposition
papers.authors: Sukmin Seo, Geewook Kim
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, CLIP, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: NAVER Cloud AI；KAIST AI
papers.intro: 本文发布首个开放的小时级自然语言时间定位基准ExtremeWhenBench（2,273个查询/194个视频，平均75.7分钟），并通过实证分解证明小时级时间定位的瓶颈是搜索而非识别——所有开放Video-LLM在小时级视频上性能崩塌，而帧级检索基线反而超越它们，85%的失败归因于搜索失败，retr…

papers.title: Bridging the Modality Gap in Forensic Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Ricardo González-Gazapo, Annette Morales-González, Yoanna Martínez-Díaz, Heydi Méndez-Vázquez, Milton García-Borroto
papers.tags: image retrieval, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: Advanced Technologies Application Center (CENATAV), Havana, Cuba; Centro de Sistemas Complejos, Facultad de Física, Universidad de La Habana, Havana, Cuba
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个统一的法医图像检索框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）自动为所有查询和图库图像生成结构化文本描述，并通过句子转换器嵌入进行文本比较，结合视觉与文本相似度的多模态融合策略，显著提升了在纹身照片、证人描述、手绘草图及面部草图四种典型法医场景下的检索准确性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: VOID: Defeating Unauthorized Mimicry in Latent Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Chunlin Qiu, Ang Li, Tianxiao Huang, Ruilin Gan, Yunjie Ge, Shenyi Zhang, Huayi Duan, Lingchen Zhao, Chao Shen, Qian Wang
papers.affiliations: 1 School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University; 2 School of Computer Science, Wuhan University; 3 Institute for Math&AI, Wuhan University; 4 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); 5 School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University
papers.intro: VOID提出了一种新的语义破坏范式，通过利用和操纵LDM的固有随机性（放大编码不确定性和抵消条件引导），实现了对未授权模仿的强大防御，同时保持了被保护图像的视觉质量。

papers.title: Bridging Day and Night: Unsupervised Cross-Domain Re-Identification with Synergistic Prompt and Prototype Learning
papers.authors: Jiyang Xu, Rui Liu, Hang Dai
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science, Wuhan University, Wuhan, China
papers.intro: 论文提出一种无监督跨域昼夜车辆重识别框架，通过协同实例感知提示学习和跨域原型匹配，在不使用人工标注的情况下实现了与全监督方法可比的Rank-1识别准确率。

papers.title: Q-Fold: Query-Aware Focus-Context Spatio-Temporal Folding for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Biao Tang, Xu Chen, Shuxiang Gou, Jingyi Yuan, Yuhan Zhang, Chenqiang Gao
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: 中山大学深圳校区、哈尔滨工业大学（深圳）、电子科技大学深圳高等研究院
papers.intro: Q-Fold提出了一种无需训练的查询感知焦点-上下文时空折叠框架，通过将连续时间片段组织为异构的焦点-上下文表示，在固定视觉预算下同时保留关键视觉证据和广泛时序覆盖，显著提升长视频理解性能。

papers.title: MFEN:Multi-Frequency Expert Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-ID
papers.authors: Xulin Li, Yan Lu, Bin Liu, Qinhong Yang, Qi Chu, Tao Gong, Nenghai Yu
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China, China; Anhui Province Key Laboratory of Digital Security, China; The Chinese University of Hong Kong, China
papers.intro: 本文提出一种多频率专家网络（MFEN），通过多频段自适应调制与混合专家融合，结合随机频率增强（RFA）和频率辅助优化（FAO），在频率域全面学习以缓解可见光-红外模态差异，从而提升VI-ReID性能。

papers.title: Plan-and-Verify Video Reward Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Scene Graph Grounding
papers.authors: Hyomin Kim, Junghye Kim, Joanie Hayoun Chung, Yoonjin Oh, Kyungjae Lee, Sungbin Lim, Sungwoong Kim
papers.tags: video generation, scene understanding, video segmentation, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: Korea University（高丽大学）
papers.intro: SG-PVR提出了一种基于时空场景图（Spatio-Temporal Scene Graph）的"规划-验证"（Plan-and-Verify）视频奖励推理框架，通过将提示词分解为原子验证声明并逐一对照视频和场景图进行验证，实现了细粒度的语义对齐评估。

papers.title: Learning Instance-Adaptive Low-Rank Orthogonal Subspaces for Clothes-Changing Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Dong-Woo Kim, Tae-Kyun Kim
papers.tags: CLIP, image retrieval, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: School of Computing, KAIST, Daejeon, South Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出Ortho-ReID，通过Transformer-based Basis Maker将VLM文本描述中提取的低秩衣物先验自适应地细化为实例级衣物子空间，并利用正交投影几何约束实现衣物无关的身份特征提取，在多个CC-ReID基准上取得最先进性能。

papers.title: SceneMiner: Identity-Preserving Multi-Task Fine-Tuning for Unified BEV Scene Mining
papers.authors: Abdalmalek Aburaddaha, Venkatraman Narayanan, Keval Thaker, Samir A. Rawashdeh
papers.affiliations: University of Michigan-Dearborn
papers.intro: SceneMiner提出了一个统一的、仅相机的BEV场景挖掘流水线，通过身份保持的多任务微调，在单次前向传播中从冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络中发射出互补的挖掘信号（检索嵌入、场景标签分布和基于物理的风险评分），且无需LiDAR或雷达，训练参数仅约102k。

papers.title: PT-WNO: Point Transformer with Wavelet Neural Operator for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Nhut Le, Maryam Rahnemoonfar
papers.affiliations: Lehigh University
papers.intro: 本文提出PT-WNO，通过在序列化点云Transformer骨架的跳跃连接旁集成一个共享的小波神经算子（WNO）分支，在规则3D体素网格上显式建模全局多尺度上下文，从而提升点云语义分割性能。

papers.title: 3D-CBM: A Framework for Concept-Based Interpretability in Generative 3D Modeling
papers.authors: Ahmad Al-Kabbany
papers.affiliations: Ahmad Al-Kabbany - Yubree Labs, Ottawa K2M1T2, Canada Ahmad Al-Kabbany - Multimedia Interaction and Communication Lab, Arab Academy for Science and Technology, Alexandria 21937, Egypt
papers.intro: 本文提出了3D-CBM框架，首次将概念瓶颈模型形式化地集成到3D生成管线中，通过多层级概念分类器实现点云/网格生成的可解释性与测试时人类干预。

papers.title: From Simulation to Real-World: An In-Field 6D Pose Dataset and Baseline for Robotic Strawberry Harvesting
papers.authors: Woojung Son, Won Suk Lee, Zijing Huang, Daeun Choi, Catia Silva, Yu She, Yan Gu
papers.affiliations: University of Florida, Purdue University
papers.intro: 本文首次在真实草莓田间收集12,040张6D位姿真值图像，并构建了场景级真实感的合成数据集，通过基线实验量化了sim-to-real差距，证明合成数据训练的性能显著低于真实数据，且深度翻译误差是主要瓶颈。
